{{Quote|Is your network secure?|MerenData tagline|<ref name="Hnn ad">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/468_4.gif|text=Is your network secure?}}</ref>}}
'''MerenData''' was a data security and espionage corporation. The firm was best known for its [[espionage droid]]s based on [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO protocol droids]], but also for their network security and [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] investigation capabilities. It was one of the original non-voting [[contributing sponsor]]s of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].

It initially supported the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and did not sell to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It eventually replaced the board members and opened ties to the New Republic and their markets.<ref name="SGtD">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
MerenData was founded some time before [[3956 BBY]], releasing the [[S6-series security/maintenance droid]] and [[K-X12 probe droid]]. Both were extremely popular with not only the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], but the civilian market also. Around the same time [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] released its successful [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]], MerenData offered a conversion package, to turn a 3PO droid into an [[espionage droid]].<ref name="SGtD" />

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], MerenData undertook their own investigation of Pro-[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] appearing on the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC's]] data server, by slicing into the system and purging it. Their findings concluded that the propaganda was inserted by well-backed slicers, disagreeing with the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]].<ref name="Hnn-Datanet Propaganda the Real Deal?">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|business/13228_2.html|Datanet Propaganda the Real Deal?}}</ref>

MerenData sponsored articles on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|Holonet News]] during the Separatist Crisis. After a slicing of the free edition, Holonet News began using MerenData's [[Socketguard]]s.<ref name="Hnn-HoloNet News is Back and Secure">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_5.html|HoloNet News is Back and Secure}}</ref>

At an unknown time, MerenData released its [[A4 laboratory assistant droid/Legends|A4 laboratory assistant droid]], which was very successful, until [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] started promoting these droids to chief surgeon. The droids lacked an advanced independent decision module, causing the droid to replace healthy parts with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. This blunder was only the first in a series of failures. During the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], MerenData released the flawed [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]], which was accidentally fitted with an [[MDF motivator]], a module usually attached to [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droids]]. The EV droids were then recalled by MerenData, but it was too late to counter the damage caused. It was a blunder which MerenData never fully recovered from. MerenData continued to market droids to the Galactic Empire, such as the [[V-series droid supervisor/Legends|V-series droid supervisor]] and [[GD16-series pilot droid]], but by then the company had lost its reputation.
